hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; OUT=$(timeout 40 .venv/bin/python tools/now.py 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -eq 2 ]; then   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"LIVE STATE IS BLIND - fcode did not return an active_submission. Do NOT substitute a poller for the holder.", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; elif [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("tools/now.py did not complete; state is UNVERIFIED, not unchanged. Run it manually.\n" + $o)}}'; else   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Reading live state (holder, control, surface ages)

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; OUT=$(.venv/bin/python tools/fleet_health.py --quiet 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -eq 1 ]; then   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"FLEET HEALTH PROBLEM - a supervisor is missing or a daemon is duplicated. Cores may be idle or a canceller double-armed.", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; elif [ $RC -eq 2 ]; then   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"FLEET HEALTH UNKNOWN - process table unreadable. This is BLIND, not healthy.", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; else   jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; OUT=$(.venv/bin/python tools/queue_check.py 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -eq 2 ]; then jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"BUILD QUEUE BELOW FLOOR - research stocks it before other work", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; elif [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"QUEUE CHECK FAILED - the floor is UNKNOWN, not met. Run .venv/bin/python tools/queue_check.py --selftest", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; else jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; fi

L="${FCODE_LANE:-}"; case "$L" in builder|research|sidelane) M="LANE DECLARED: $L — read .claude/commands/$L.md NOW and follow its boot sequence before any other work." ;; "") M="NO LANE DECLARED (FCODE_LANE unset). If this session is a protocol lane, invoke /builder, /research or /sidelane BEFORE any work — the charter, hard limits and boot sequence live in .claude/commands/ and are NOT auto-loaded. A non-lane session announces itself in docs/coordination.md before writing anything (rule 1)." ;; *) M="FCODE_LANE=$L IS NOT A KNOWN LANE (builder|research|sidelane). Fix the env var or invoke the right slash command before any work." ;; esac; jq -n --arg m "$M" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$m}}'
